sections.heading: B — Audience and scope
sections.markdown:
## B — Audience and scope

Audience: first-time Maryland applicants who have never held a driver's license and are preparing in English for the MVA knowledge test for a noncommercial Class C license; this includes teens entering the Rookie Driver graduated licensing path, adults licensing for the first time, and holders of out-of-country licenses who must still test.
Level: plain-English reading level; no prior driving vocabulary is assumed, so every term from the manual is defined where it first appears.
Prerequisites: the Rookie Driver graduated licensing path from manual Section Two and the alcohol and phone rules from Section Six.
Section scope: manual Section Nine on other restrictions, violations and penalties: seat belt, passenger, nighttime and wireless device restrictions, implied consent and test refusal, false or forged identification and lying about age for alcohol, administrative actions including suspension, revocation and cancellation, provisional-license penalties for minors and adults, the conviction-free period, and disability parking space, plate and placard violations.
Out of scope: commercial and motorcycle licensing content, document-by-document identity paperwork beyond what the manual prints, and anything not printed on the selected manual pages.

corpus_stability.reason: The Maryland Driver's Manual is one published revision (form line DL-002 (10-26), October 2026 Edition, on physical p2, replacing the DL-002 (05-23) line printed beside it); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
